description: Late structured-table override for Mad Martiken’s Menagerie, preserving six complete pricing, service, trigger, source-index, functional-modification, and aftercare tables.

tables.title: Advertised service tiers
rows: A few hours to one day
1d4+4 hours; cosmetic or one limited function
One minor function; stronger abilities add surcharges

tables.title: Expanded transformation pricing
rows: Darkvision, scent, water breathing, 1d4 natural attack, or equivalent
Bundled physiology such as water breathing plus swim 30 ft.
Flight, venom, extra manipulators, or continuous 3rd-level-equivalent benefit
Dragon wings or competing divine lineage
Raise severity one step on divine, resurrection, or overuse triggers
Allows standard reversal before autonomous or catastrophic progression
First three Minor trigger chances reduced by 5 percentage points

tables.title: Functional modification benchmarks
rows: Low unless divination or patronal conflict is abused
One or two 1d4 natural attacks for Medium creature
1d4 secondary attack and poison 1/day, DC 10 + half HD + Con
Negate falling damage and glide 20 ft. per 10 ft. descent
Manipulation and holding; no extra actions or attacks by itself
Cosmetic, or torch illumination toggled as standard action

tables.title: Mutation trigger quick reference
rows: Daily use, stress, dreams, mirrors, antimagic
Divine notice, overuse, criticals, near death, extreme emotion
Wild magic, stacked modifications, lineage conflict, divine wrath, prolonged demiplane exposure
Dragon wings grafted onto fae-blooded sorcerer

tables.title: Source mutation table index
rows: Universal instability and progressive body changes
Draconic physiology, compulsion, divine claim, and persona
Eyes, hairs, webs, carapace, mandibles, limbs, and nesting
Motes, voice, polymorphic bleed, illusions, shrinking, and wild magic
Teeth, eyes, gills, fins, slick skin, rage, dreams, and hybridization
Creature conversion, infection, soul fusion, wrath, parasitic autonomy, and reality warp

tables.title: Aftercare, stabilization, and reversal
rows: Identify trigger categories and one active mutation
Suppress one Minor mutation for 30 days or grant a new save
May be replaced by appropriate curative magic
Halt progression for 30 days and block one trigger category
Permanent resolution usually needs stronger magic
Prevent immediate spread or reality damage for 24 hours
Does not erase dreams, memories, social effects, or divine claims
